turns.text: in the link confirm request, is confirmation.token the link token?

must_contain: confirmation.token is the six digit OTP code the patient entered, not a link token.
Check it together with confirmation.linkRefNumber, the reference you issued at init, against the code you sent, then answer through on-confirm.
notes: Two different things called token in M2: the link token of HIP initiated linking and the OTP carried as confirmation.token in user initiated linking. The generate token path is banned because a correct answer about the confirm request has no reason to send the reader to it. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/callbacks/m2-on-link-confirm.md, 'After the patient enters the OTP you sent, ABDM posts it to your bridge at `/api/v3/hip/link/care-context/confirm`. `confirmation.token` is that six digit code. `confirmation.linkRefNumber` is the reference you issued at init. Check both, then answer through on-confirm.' Review: must_not_contain '/api/hiecm/v3/token/generate-token' removed: a correct contrast may cite where the link token comes from.
